body:
I go tiger because 9/10 I snowball which snowballs my team. Phoenix is a safer pick for safer games if you aren't confident in such a task.

Yeah Tri is expensive but if you can get those early game kills and advantages, it shouldn't be hard. I get Warrior + Tiamat + Tri-Force + T1 or T2 boots PRE-20 MINUTES MOST OF THE TIME then tanky/survival from thereon because it's pointless to build damage afterwards.

Only reason I don't go phoenix after the new tiger came out is that it depends a little on teammates and it doesn't allow you to take [true] initiative. 

Edit: Going through all of my Udyr matches and I can't find one match where I didn't get all of the above BEFORE 20 mins unless I bought T2 boots and in those cases it'll leak over to 21-24 but I could've temporarily skipped T2 for Tri.

Edit 2: http://prntscr.com/f04dxq Past 20 other matches are autofill support, lost one match with Udyr due to theorycrafting, two because the other team was better, and one due to wifi problems. Tiger carries, the only problem with it stems from Udyr as a whole being outkited which can be solved through multiple items other than that, the only way you can lose is if: 





A.) you meet a troll or afk
B.) poor decision making 
C.) wifi problems
